WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Owner is thefee owner of120FultonStreet,NewYork,NY(Block 78, Lot 45 on the Tax Map of the City of New York (the “Tax Map"), New York County (the "Owner Land"), and the building and improvements thereon (the “Owner Building"; and the Owner Landand the Owner Building, as the case may be, are herein collectively referred to as the "Owner Parcel") which is more fully described on Exhibit A, attached hereto; B-78 New York, NY (Block 78, Lot 47 on the Tax Map, New York County (the “Developer Land"), L- 45,47 which is more fully described on Exhibit B, attached hereto; WHEREAS, Developer may construct a new building, all or a portion of which will be on the Developer Land and/or any Additional Parcel (as hereinafter defined), and construct other improvements associated with such new building (the new building and improvements, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements,repairs or rebuilding thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as the“Developer Building”; and the Developer Land and the Developer Building, as the case may be, are herein collectively referred to as the “Developer Parcel"); WHEREAS,the Owner Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution(ashereinafterdefined),thanisnow availableforuse on the OwnerParcel pursuant to hereinafter defined); Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions-Expansion (112 Fulton Street) and the Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions-Expansion (7 Dutch and 45 John) (collectively, the “Declaration"), the OwnerParcel,theDeveloperParcel,and thelandsknown as86NassauStreet(Block78,Lot40 on the Tax Map,New York County),88 Nassau Street (Block 78,Lot 42 on the Tax Map,New York County), 122 Fulton Street (Block 78, Lot 44 on the Tax Map, New York County), 41-43 John Street (Block 78,Lots 1101-1102 on the Tax Map,NewYork County),80-82Nassau Street -1

i (Block 78,Lots 1201-1202 on the Tax Map, New York County), 9-15 Dutch Street (Block 78, Lots 1301-1303 on the Tax Map, New York County),45 John Street (Block 78,Lots 1701-1787 on the Tax Map, New York County), and 7 Dutch Street (Block 78, Lots 1801-1805 on the Tax Map, New York County) (the “Other Parcels"), have heretofore been merged in to a single zoning lot in accordance with the definition of the term“zoning lot” in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (such zoning lot, as the same may be enlarged in accordance with the Declaration and the terms of this Agreement, is herein referred to as the “Combined Zoning Lot")  WHEREAS, Owner was a party to those certain Zoning Lot Development Agreements, each dated as of May 30, 2013,and recorded in the Recording Office as CRFN#s 2013000247601，2013000247617，2013000247614,and 2013000247610 and the Zoning Lot Development Agreement dated as of May 19, 2014 pertaining to 45 John Street and 7 Dutch Street, New York,NY recorded in the Recording Office as CRFN# 2014000190155 (collectively,the "Other Parcel ZLDAs")and each of the amendments thereto(collectively,the Other Parcel ZLDAs and the amendments thereto,the“Amended OtherParcel ZLDAs") listed on Schedule A, attached hereto; WHEREAS, pursuant to the Amended Other Parcel ZLDAs, Owner was the transferee of. the “Excess Development Rights”(including bonus Development Rights) that are appurtenant to the Other Parcels (the “Other Parcel Excess Development Rights"), and, collectively,.the land defined herein as the Owner Parcel and the Developer Parcel was the site to which the Other Parcel Excess Development Rights were transferred and conveyed; WHEREAS, Owner has conveyed to Developer the Developer Land and has retained to itself the OwnerParcel; 4 WHEREAS, in connection with such conveyance, Owner and Developer desire to allocate the Other Parcel Excess Development Rights and the Development Rights appurtenant to the OwnerParcel between the OwnerParcel and theDeveloperParcel; 5 WHEREAS, the Developer Parcel and/or the Combined Zoning Lot may be the Developer may acquire such Additional Development Rights for utilization on Developer Parcel or the Combined Zoning Lot (other than the OwnerParcel);
